results.title: Vinski 2
results.overview: The town of Hömpstad is once again under threat from criminals and Vinski's help is needed. When the criminals manage to steal the invisibility powder for themselves, Vinski has a real showdown on his hands.

results.title: Sinatritude
results.overview: Mimmo has always claimed to be Frank Sinatra’s son. When his cousin Andrea, an aspiring filmmaker, casts him as the lead in his graduation film, Mimmo sees it as the opportunity of a lifetime. The two set off on a journey through the singer’s supposed places of origin, in search of a relative willing to take a DNA test.

results.title: Les Folies Gruss, 50 ans à Paris
results.original_title: Les Folies Gruss, 50 ans à Paris
results.overview: Stephan Gruss is proud to unveil a show co-written with author and composer Grégory Garell, in an original setting designed by Grégory Antoine. Together, they showcase the talents of 25 artists, 50 horses from the cavalry, the Folies Gruss orchestra, and the performances of two young singers: Candice Parise and Xavier Ducrocq. For Louise, a sparkling young singer, joining the Folies Gruss troupe is a childhood dream. Recorded on March 29, 2025, in Paris's 16th arrondissement.

results.title: The Hostage's Hero
results.overview: Ship hijackings in the Malacca Strait are on the rise and attracting global attention. Lieutenant Colonel Taufiq is reassigned to Indonesia to lead a maritime patrol aboard the KRI Karel Satsuitubun. While on their mission, they face the hijacking of the MT Pematang tanker by a group of pirates. Amidst the dangerous task, the soldiers are faced with a dilemma between national responsibility and family.

results.title: City Boys: Golden Boyz
results.overview: After a distant relative dies, Malone stands to inherit 9 million euros — but he must earn a university degree to get his hands on the money.

results.title: Georgia Peach
results.overview: A nurse in recovery from alcoholism must confront her past and her brother's growing demands, risking everything she's worked for to reclaim her life or lose it all to her inner demons.

results.title: Nuisance Bear
results.overview: A polar bear is forced to navigate a human world of tourists, wildlife officers, and hunters as its ancient migration collides with modern life. When a sacred predator is branded a nuisance, it becomes unclear who truly belongs in this shared landscape.

results.title: The Curse
results.overview: After seeing her friend’s disturbing social media posts, Riko tries to intervene to help her but fails to prevent her from dying a mysterious, violent death. Convinced there is more to the story than a suicide, Riko dives into a world of memes, influencers, and posting for attention. As the pile of bodies grows, and Riko faces her own possible curse, she and her friends travel to Taiwan to find the source of this demonic social media killer.

results.title: Romance at Hope Ranch
results.overview: Hope Morgan sets out to begin a new chapter of her life—fulfilling her childhood dream of running a ranch in the picturesque town of Ruidoso, New Mexico and reviving the beloved Giddy Up Gala.

results.title: Totality
results.overview: Twenty-one film crews from Mexico to Canada capture the 2024 total solar eclipse, following several groups of people in preparation for this extraordinary event. This immersive cinematic experience explores this magically cosmic spectacle and the collective human awakening it inspired.

results.title: Adulto/Homem
results.overview: What can 20 actors’ faces, waiting for a casting call, reveal?

results.title: Black Market
results.overview: When a rival kidnaps Adesua’s daughter and threatens to burn everything down, the crew faces their most dangerous job yet, one wrong move and they lose more than the money. They lose each other.

results.title: LOOP
results.overview: In a near-future world where technology has rendered most human labor obsolete, Zoe Pearce, a despairing artist, finds herself selected as a finalist for the universe challenge. This exclusive competition promises membership in humanity's most coveted experience: complete digital personalized immersion, where pain, suffering, and unwanted emotions are eliminated.

results.title: Alien Disclosure Day
results.overview: A deep space mining ship returns to Earth carrying deadly alien stowaways. The aliens immediately launch a brutal attack on Earth. Now humanity must fight back, board the vessel, and destroy it before the planet is lost forever.

results.title: Deathwoods
results.overview: A weekend of camping intended to break Scott out of his post breakup depression, quickly turns  into a weekend of bloodshed, as his friends are picked off one by one by the urban legend that haunts the  woods surrounding the small town of Old Hickory, Tennessee.

results.title: The Table: Day and Night
results.overview: In a bustling café where lives briefly intersect, serendipity takes centre stage. A man and a woman share the same eccentric dream – will fate bring them together? Old classmates run into each other after years: a sweet second chance or a bitter reality check? A director approaches a novelist he admires to find out if the connection on page is merely delusional. A K-idol meets her first love, where the prospect of parting ways leaves them feeling wistful.

results.title: Home Entertainment
results.overview: Florian and Marie want to spend a cozy evening on the sofa watching a movie. But that's more difficult than expected: the couple navigate through a digital world full of streaming portals, voucher codes, delivery service apps and broken remote controls and keep tripping over themselves in the process.

results.title: Hallowarrior
results.overview: Pumpkin, the last girl on earth and sole survivor of a humanity-ending plague, scavenges the wasteland for supplies on the eve of Halloween. Pumpkin’s lonely holiday ritual is interrupted by the arrival of a savage gang of raiders at her doorstep, led by the fearsome Thalia. Outnumbered and armed with candy, wit and weapons, Pumpkin must ferociously fight back to survive the night.

results.title: Eruption
results.overview: Forced to give up the mice his son Tim deeply loves, Marc makes an impulsive decision while hiding a truth too painful to confront.
